fusions.name: Brow-First Shove
fusions.desc: Rams the haft into the target, dealing 12 blunt damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scree From Above
fusions.desc: Throws from the high ground, dealing 30 rock damage to the first enemy it meets and knocking loose stone that hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Butt Set in Rock
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Moved
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
